```bash
import re, pathlib
blog = pathlib.Path('content/english/blog')
rows = []
for p in sorted(blog.glob('*.md')):
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    m = re.search(r'^social_media_intro:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'|[^\n]*)', text, re.M)
    if not m:
        rows.append((p.name, None, 0))
        continue

    if raw.startswith('"') and raw.endswith('"'):
        val = bytes(raw[1:-1], 'utf-8').decode('unicode_escape') if '\\' in raw else raw[1:-1]
        # simpler:
        import ast
        try:
            val = ast.literal_eval(raw)
        except:
            val = raw.strip('"')
    elif raw.startswith("'") and raw.endswith("'"):
        val = raw[1:-1]
    else:

over = [r for r in rows if r[1] and r[2] > 200]
print(f'Over 200: {len(over)}')
# article-first patterns
bad_openers = []
for name, val, n in rows:
    if not val: continue
    low = val.lower()
    if any(low.startswith(x) for x in ['here\'s an article', 'i wrote', 'new article', 'here\'s a post', 'check out', 'excited', 'just published', 'new post']):
        bad_openers.append(name)

    print(val[:220] if val else 'MISSING')
print('\n--- PUBLISHED (no __) ---')

draft = [r for r in rows if r[0].startswith('__')]
print(f'Published: {len(pub)}, Drafts: {len(draft)}')
```

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import re, ast, pathlib
blog = pathlib.Path('content/english/blog')

def get_intro(text):
    m = re.search(r'^social_media_intro:\s*(.+)$', text, re.M)
    if not m: return None
    raw = m.group(1).strip()
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(raw) if raw[0] in '"\'' else raw
    except:
        return raw.strip('"').strip("'")

def get_title(text):
    m = re.search(r'^title:\s*(.+)$', text, re.M)
    if not m: return '?'
    raw = m.group(1).strip()
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(raw) if raw[0] in '"\'' else raw
    except:
        return raw.strip('"')

issues = []
all_intros = []
for p in sorted(blog.glob('*.md')):
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    intro = get_intro(text)
    title = get_title(text)
    if intro is None:
        issues.append((p.name, 'MISSING', title, ''))
        continue
    n = len(intro)
    flags = []
    low = intro.lower()
    # CTA checks
    if 'comment' not in low:
        flags.append('no-comment-CTA')
    if not any(x in low for x in ['article', 'write-up', 'writeup', 'checklist', 'post ', 'full article', 'piece']):
        # vague link only?
        if 'link in' in low and 'article' not in low:
            flags.append('vague-link-not-article')
        elif 'article' not in low and 'write-up' not in low and 'checklist' not in low:
            flags.append('article-word-weak')
    # article-first
    if any(low.startswith(x) for x in [
        "here's an article", "i wrote", "new article", "here's a post",
        "check out my", "excited to", "just published", "new post",
        "here's my article", "article in the comments about",
        "i wrote a post", "new article in the comments"
    ]):
        flags.append('article-first-opener')
    if n > 200:
        flags.append(f'over-{n}')
    if n < 80:
        flags.append(f'short-{n}')
    # payoff: looks like only hook + CTA?
    parts = re.split(r'[.!?]\s+', intro.strip())
    if len(parts) < 2:
        flags.append('one-sentence')
    all_intros.append((p.name, n, title, intro, flags))
    if flags:
        issues.append((p.name, ','.join(flags), title, intro))

print(f'Total intros: {len(all_intros)}')
print(f'With flags: {len(issues)}')
print('\n=== FLAGGED ===')
for name, flags, title, intro in issues:
    print(f'\n{name} [{flags}]')
    print(f'  TITLE: {title}')
    print(f'  INTRO ({len(intro) if intro else 0}): {intro}')

print('\n\n=== ALL INTROS ===')
for name, n, title, intro, flags in all_intros:
    mark = ' !! ' + ','.join(flags) if flags else ''
    print(f'\n## {name} ({n}){mark}')
    print(intro)
PY
```

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import re, ast, pathlib
blog = pathlib.Path('content/english/blog')

def get_intro(text):
    m = re.search(r'^social_media_intro:\s*(.+)$', text, re.M)
    if not m: return None
    raw = m.group(1).strip()
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(raw) if raw[0] in '"\'' else raw
    except:
        return raw.strip('"').strip("'")

# Preferred CTA endings
cta_re = re.compile(
    r'(Full article in the comments\.?|Article in the comments\.?|Write-up in the first comment\.?|'
    r'Checklist in the comments\.?|post linked in comments|full article - link in comments|'
    r'Full migration write-up in the comments\.?|Full birth story: article in the comments\.?|'
    r'Full \d+ kg weeknight taco pasta: article in the comments\.?|'
    r'article in the comments\.?|write-up in the comments\.?)$',
    re.I
)

# Payoff signals (what they get)
payoff_words = re.compile(
    r'\b(checklist|fix|skip|recipe|setup|map|filter|rules|stack|migration|write-up|writeup|'
    r'how I|what I|when I|why I|full |four-|five-|six-|three-|my |the living|feature map|'
    r'build log|decision|habit|cues|review|pattern|exception|routine|order|paths|'
    r'questions|verdict|cleanup|upgrade|buckets|scrapbook|birth story|method)\b',
    re.I
)

weak = []
ok = []
for p in sorted(blog.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name == '_index.md':
        continue
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    intro = get_intro(text)
    if not intro:
        weak.append((p.name, 'MISSING', intro))
        continue
    n = len(intro)
    flags = []
    # strip CTA to analyze body
    body = re.sub(
        r'[:.\-]?\s*(Full article in the comments\.?|Article in the comments\.?|'
        r'Write-up in the first comment\.?|Checklist in the comments\.?|'
        r'post linked in comments\.?|full article - link in comments\.?|'
        r'Full migration write-up in the comments\.?|'
        r'article in the comments when you publish\.?|'
        r'article in the comments\.?)\s*$',
        '', intro, flags=re.I
    ).strip(' :-')
    # CTA present?
    if 'comment' not in intro.lower():
        flags.append('NO_CTA')
    if 'article' not in intro.lower() and 'write-up' not in intro.lower() and 'checklist' not in intro.lower() and 'post linked' not in intro.lower():
        flags.append('NO_ARTICLE_WORD')
    # preferred closer style
    if not re.search(r'article in the comments|write-up in the|checklist in the comments|post linked in comments|full article', intro, re.I):
        flags.append('NONPREFERRED_CTA')
    # payoff in body?
    if not payoff_words.search(body) and not payoff_words.search(intro):
        flags.append('WEAK_PAYOFF')
    # hook: first clause too generic?
    first = re.split(r'[.!?]\s+', intro)[0]
    if any(first.lower().startswith(x) for x in ['here\'s', 'i wrote', 'new article', 'check out', 'excited']):
        flags.append('ARTICLE_FIRST')
    if n > 200:
        flags.append(f'OVER_{n}')
    # colon-glued CTA without clear mid payoff (hook: article in comments)
    # e.g. "something: article in the comments" where something is only hook
    m = re.match(r'^(.+?):\s*(article|full article|checklist|write-up)', intro, re.I)
    if m:
        before = m.group(1)
        # if before is short and no payoff words, flag
        if len(before) < 60 and not payoff_words.search(before):
            flags.append('HOOK_ONLY_BEFORE_COLON')
    
    if flags:
        weak.append((p.name, ','.join(flags), intro, body))
    else:
        ok.append(p.name)

print(f'OK: {len(ok)}  WEAK/FLAGGED: {len(weak)}')
print('\n=== FLAGGED FOR REWRITE ===')
for name, flags, intro, body in weak:
    print(f'\n{name} [{flags}] ({len(intro)} chars)')
    print(f'  {intro}')
    print(f'  BODY: {body}')
```

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import re, ast, pathlib
blog = pathlib.Path('content/english/blog')

def get_intro(text):
    m = re.search(r'^social_media_intro:\s*(.+)$', text, re.M)
    if not m: return None
    raw = m.group(1).strip()
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(raw) if raw[0] in '"\'' else raw
    except:
        return raw.strip('"').strip("'")

fails = []
stats = {'n':0, 'max':0, 'min':999, 'cta_article':0, 'cta_checklist':0, 'cta_writeup':0, 'cta_full':0}
for p in sorted(blog.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name == '_index.md':
        continue
    intro = get_intro(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if not intro:
        fails.append((p.name, 'MISSING'))
        continue
    stats['n'] += 1
    stats['max'] = max(stats['max'], len(intro))
    stats['min'] = min(stats['min'], len(intro))
    low = intro.lower()
    if len(intro) > 200:
        fails.append((p.name, f'OVER {len(intro)}'))
    if 'comment' not in low:
        fails.append((p.name, 'NO comment'))
    if not any(w in low for w in ['article', 'write-up', 'writeup', 'checklist', 'post linked']):
        fails.append((p.name, 'NO article-word'))
    if any(low.startswith(x) for x in ["here's an article", 'i wrote a', 'new article', "here's a post about"]):
        fails.append((p.name, 'ARTICLE_FIRST'))
    if 'checklist in the comments' in low:
        stats['cta_checklist'] += 1
    elif 'full article' in low or 'full migration' in low or 'full birth' in low:
        stats['cta_full'] += 1
    elif 'write-up' in low:
        stats['cta_writeup'] += 1
    elif 'article in the comments' in low:
        stats['cta_article'] += 1
    else:
        fails.append((p.name, f'UNUSUAL_CTA: {intro[-60:]}'))

print('Stats:', stats)
print('Fails:', len(fails))
for f in fails:
    print(' ', f)
```

```bash
        return ast.literal_eval(raw) if raw[0] in '"\'' else raw
    except:
        return raw.strip('"').strip("'")

fails = []
for p in sorted(blog.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name == '_index.md': continue
    intro = get_intro(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    low = intro.lower()
    if len(intro) > 200 or 'comment' not in low:
        fails.append(p.name)
    if not any(w in low for w in ['article', 'write-up', 'writeup', 'checklist', 'post linked']):
        fails.append(p.name)
print('All pass' if not fails else fails)
# show 5 published samples
for name in ['tennis-crowd-etiquette.md','what-i-look-for-in-wireless-earphones.md','extension-cord.md','static-site-vs-cms.md','__ikea-frakta-bag.md']:
    print(f'\n{name} ({len(get_intro((blog/name).read_text()))}):')
    print(get_intro((blog/name).read_text()))
```
